note: Control IDs and short titles only. Summaries are our own one-line paraphrase, not ISO text. The published standard governs exact wording.

items.title: AI policy
items.summary: Document an AI policy for developing or using AI systems.

items.title: Alignment with other organizational policies
items.summary: Check how other policies (security, privacy, quality) apply to or are affected by AI.

items.title: Review of the AI policy
items.summary: Review the AI policy at planned intervals so it stays suitable.

items.title: AI roles and responsibilities
items.summary: Define and allocate roles and responsibilities for AI.

items.title: Reporting of concerns
items.summary: Give people a way to report concerns about AI systems.

items.title: Resource documentation
items.summary: Identify and document resources needed across the AI life cycle.

items.title: Data resources
items.summary: Document the data resources used by AI systems.

items.title: Tooling resources
items.summary: Document tools used for the AI system.

items.title: System and computing resources
items.summary: Document system and computing resources used.

items.title: Human resources
items.summary: Document human resources and competences needed.

items.title: AI system impact assessment process
items.summary: Set a process to assess potential consequences of AI systems.

items.title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
items.summary: Document and keep impact assessment results.

items.title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups
items.summary: Assess effects on individuals and groups across the life cycle.

items.title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
items.summary: Assess effects on society.

items.title: Objectives for responsible development of AI system
items.summary: Set objectives that guide responsible development.

items.title: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
items.summary: Define processes for responsible design and development.

items.title: AI system requirements and specification
items.summary: Specify and document requirements for new or changed AI systems.

items.title: Documentation of AI system design and development
items.summary: Document design and development based on objectives and requirements.

items.title: AI system verification and validation
items.summary: Define and document verification and validation measures and criteria.

items.title: AI system deployment
items.summary: Plan deployment and meet requirements before release.

items.title: AI system operation and monitoring
items.summary: Define elements for ongoing operation, monitoring and repair.

items.title: AI system technical documentation
items.summary: Provide technical documentation to relevant interested parties.

items.title: AI system recording of event logs
items.summary: Decide when to enable event logging, at minimum during use.

items.title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
items.summary: Define and run data management processes for development.

items.title: Acquisition of data
items.summary: Document how data is acquired and selected.

items.title: Quality of data for AI systems
items.summary: Define and document data quality requirements and check data meets them.

items.title: Data provenance
items.summary: Record the provenance of data across the life cycle.

items.title: Data preparation
items.summary: Define criteria and methods for preparing data.

items.title: System documentation and information for users
items.summary: Give users the information they need about the AI system.

items.title: External reporting
items.summary: Let interested parties report adverse impacts of the system.

items.title: Communication of incidents
items.summary: Plan how to communicate incidents to users.

items.title: Information for interested parties
items.summary: Decide what AI system information to report to interested parties.

items.title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
items.summary: Define processes for responsible use.

items.title: Objectives for responsible use of AI system
items.summary: Set objectives that guide responsible use.

items.title: Intended use of the AI system
items.summary: Use the system as intended and per its documentation.

items.title: Allocating responsibilities
items.summary: Allocate responsibilities between the organization, partners, suppliers and customers.

items.title: Suppliers
items.summary: Make sure supplier services and products align with responsible AI.

items.title: Customers
items.summary: Consider customer expectations and needs for responsible AI.
